analyst_view.overall: A mid-table Friday-night game at Butarque: Luis Carrión's Leganés (15th, 18 points) host Ferran Costa's Sabadell (14th, 19 points), both about five points above the drop zone. Leganés have won their last two league games, the latest 3-1 at Andorra, who played 74 minutes with ten men after Solozábal's red card; Sabadell are winless in five league games and have drawn 7 of 15. The main change since the last view is Álvaro Morata: the numbers take him out for one to two weeks (about -16% on Leganés' goals), but Vavel quotes Carrión calling it only a load warning and says he trained on 25 and 26 November, so he looks likely to play (one outlet, not confirmed by the club), and the club also has Pulido and Tejero back. Sabadell are still without top scorer Gioacchini (counted) and Arthur is doubtful (one report). The referee is José Antonio Sánchez Villalobos (6.2 cards a game), whose record the numbers now count.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.6 goals, 0.8 each, after taking about 16% off Leganés for Morata and 12.5% off Sabadell for Gioacchini. Vavel quotes Carrión calling Morata's problem only a load warning and says he trained all week, so the deduction for him looks too big; as only one outlet has it and he may not last 90 minutes, I give back about a third, +5%, about 1.7. Sabadell, who have scored 13 in 15 games, are not expected to score more.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, split almost evenly, with small additions for both sides' recent corner counts. Leganés play a 4-4-2 that Carrión calls offensive and Sabadell a 5-3-2 that defends deep and breaks; Morata's likely return changes who finishes, not how often Leganés win corners, so I stay at about 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 8.1 cards, very high for Segunda: they add 16% for Leganés' 27 cards in six games, 11% for Sabadell's and 21% for referee Sánchez Villalobos (6.2 cards a game). Both clubs are among the most booked (Leganés 46 yellows and 3 reds, Sabadell 45 and 2), but all of that is already on the list, and there is no derby or big stake, so I stay at about 8.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, 14.9 for Sabadell, because Leganés have let opponents shoot a lot lately (104 in six), which the numbers count with +7.9%. Some of that came from Andorra shooting while a man down and chasing the game, but Carrión admits his attacking style leaves gaps; nothing new points either way, so I stay at about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target, 4.3 for Leganés, already lifted for their sharp recent shooting (33 on target in six) but with Morata taken out. With Morata reportedly training and Carrión saying the side works better with him and Millán together, I add a little, +3%, about 8.1; it stays small because his fitness is one outlet's report.
